mapping_basis: The read-only D097–D099 readiness record maps caption labels #1–#10 to canonical stanzas 1–10 and supplies exact reference-photo hashes. Filenames alone are not mapping authority.
source_photo_role: User-supplied image for story/cast context only; not generated art, style anchor, or approval.

references.observed_reference: Crowned blue Vishnu fills the image among devotees; the posed figure has several arms and one large leg, with a temple at right. The fresh scene follows the three-stride verse and the Vamana/Trivikrama two-arm continuity contract, not the source anatomy or glossy finish.
references.mapping_note: Readiness maps caption #1 to canonical stanza 1; caption preserved verbatim. Photo is context only and differs in unsupported pose or details as noted.
